When completing a task, at the end of your reply provide a git commit message I can use. The message should be in the format of a short summary of the task, followed by a more detailed description if necessary. For example:

```
git commit -m "Implement business discovery phase" -m "Added functionality to scrape Google Maps for local businesses based on user input."
```

## Technical Details
Use pnpm as the package manager.
Use Astro as the static site generator.
Use GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
Use Cloudflare Pages for hosting.
Use Node.js and pnpm for building.
When writing code, use ES6+ syntax.
Use TypeScript for type safety.
Use Prettier for code formatting.
Use ESLint for linting.
Use Tailwind CSS or Astro components for layout and styling
Reuse CSS tokens from CustomStyles.astro for consistent design, where possible, especially with colors. 

### Content & SEO Best Practices
Ensure sites follow content best practices and are SEO optimized.
Ensure the description meta tag is set for each page.
Ensure the title tag is set for each page.
Ensure the robots meta tag is set for each page.
Ensure the canonical link tag is set for each page.
Ensure the Open Graph meta tags are set for each page.
Ensure the Twitter Card meta tags are set for each page.
Ensure the viewport meta tag is set for each page.
Ensure the favicon is set for each page.
Ensure the Apple Touch Icon is set for each page.
Pages created should be responsive and mobile friendly.
Ensure the site is accessible and follows WCAG 2.1 guidelines.
Ensure the site is performant and follows Lighthouse best practices.
Ensure Meta viewport tags in layout such as <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
